rules: Every governed vowel nucleus heads exactly one syllable in careful pronunciation.
Adjacent vowels are distinct nuclei/syllables by default unless a later explicit exception is approved.
Word-initial single consonant before a vowel is onset.
Single intervocalic consonant attaches to following vowel nucleus (V.CV).
Word-final single consonant after a vowel is coda of final syllable.
Internal clusters of two or more consonants remain unresolved.
BRIDGE forms do not induce native syllabification rules.
